note: Curated definitions. Rules and weights are given as commonly cited and were not re-verified against primary texts.

name.zh: 达利欧全天候组合(公开近似版)

attributedTo.zh: 雷·达利欧 / 桥水基金

source.title: Money: Master the Game (Tony Robbins interview with Dalio)

originalRules.en: As published by Robbins: 30% stocks, 40% long-term Treasuries, 15% intermediate Treasuries, 7.5% gold, 7.5% commodities.
originalRules.zh: 罗宾斯书中公布的配比:30%股票、40%长期美债、15%中期美债、7.5%黄金、7.5%大宗商品。

adaptation.en: The 55% bond sleeve is held as cash (0% yield), so the portfolio is far less defensive in deflation/recession; stocks, gold and broad commodities (DBC) map directly.
adaptation.zh: 55%的债券部分只能用现金替代(收益为0),因此在通缩或衰退中的防御力远不如原版;股票、黄金和大宗商品(DBC)可直接对应。

whyFamous.en: Dalio's risk-balanced portfolio is the best-known 'any economic environment' allocation.
whyFamous.zh: 达利欧的风险平衡组合是最著名的“适应任何经济环境”的资产配置。

en: Ray Dalio all weather portfolio
all weather portfolio weights
Money Master the Game all weather
zh: 达利欧全天候策略
全天候组合配置比例

honestCaveat.en: The weights are the widely quoted Robbins version, not Bridgewater's actual leveraged risk-parity fund, and with bonds replaced by cash the result differs greatly from the original.
honestCaveat.zh: 采用的是广为流传的罗宾斯版本权重,并非桥水实际使用杠杆的风险平价基金,且债券换成现金后结果与原版差异很大。

en: The 55% Treasury sleeve (long and intermediate) is cash earning 0%.
No leverage and no risk parity: Bridgewater's fund levers the bonds, this does not.
Weights are the widely quoted Robbins version, not the fund's holdings.
zh: 55% 的美债部分（长期加中期）换成了收益为 0 的现金。
没有杠杆，也不是风险平价：桥水的基金会给债券加杠杆，这里没有。
权重是广为流传的罗宾斯版本，不是基金的真实持仓。

exactRule.en: Buy 30% SPY, 7.5% GLD, 7.5% DBC and keep 55% in cash (0%). At the close of the last trading day of each year, rebalance back to those weights; in between the weights drift with prices.
exactRule.zh: 买入 30% SPY、7.5% GLD、7.5% DBC，其余 55% 持有现金（收益 0%）。每年最后一个交易日收盘时调回这组权重，其间权重随价格漂移。

name.zh: 哈利·布朗永久投资组合

source.title: Fail-Safe Investing

originalRules.en: Equal 25% in stocks, long-term government bonds, gold and cash, rebalanced when allocations drift materially (commonly annually).
originalRules.zh: 股票、长期国债、黄金、现金各占25%,配比偏离较大时(通常每年)再平衡。

adaptation.en: Long bonds are replaced by cash, giving 25% SPY, 25% GLD, 50% cash; the bond-driven protection against deflation/recession is lost.
adaptation.zh: 长期国债换成现金,变为25% SPY、25% GLD、50%现金;债券在通缩/衰退中的保护作用丧失。

whyFamous.en: A classic four-season portfolio designed to survive prosperity, inflation, deflation and recession.
whyFamous.zh: 为应对繁荣、通胀、通缩、衰退四种环境而设计的经典组合。

en: Harry Browne permanent portfolio
permanent portfolio 25% stocks bonds gold cash
Fail-Safe Investing
zh: 永久投资组合 哈利布朗
永久组合 股债金现金各25%

honestCaveat.en: Half of the original (the bond leg) is replaced by zero-yield cash, so this is a partial replica.
honestCaveat.zh: 原版的债券一半被零收益现金替代,只是部分复制。

en: The 25% long-term bond sleeve is cash earning 0%, so the deflation/recession leg of the design is missing.
Gold is the GLD ETF, stocks are SPY.
zh: 25% 的长期债券部分换成了收益为 0 的现金，设计中应对通缩和衰退的那一腿缺失。
黄金用 GLD，股票用 SPY。

exactRule.en: Buy 25% SPY and 25% GLD and keep 50% in cash (0%): the original's 25% cash plus the 25% bond sleeve that we cannot trade. Rebalance to those weights at the last close of each year.
exactRule.zh: 买入 25% SPY 和 25% GLD，其余 50% 持有现金（收益 0%）：原版本来的 25% 现金，加上我们无法交易的 25% 债券部分。每年最后一个交易日收盘调回这组权重。

source.title: Berkshire Hathaway 2013 Annual Letter to Shareholders

originalRules.en: Instructions for his wife's trust: 10% in short-term government bonds and 90% in a very low-cost S&P 500 index fund.
originalRules.zh: 对遗孀信托的建议:10%投资短期政府债券,90%投资极低费率的标普500指数基金。

adaptation.en: Short-term government bonds are replaced by cash; SPY stands in for the S&P 500 index fund.
adaptation.zh: 短期政府债券用现金替代;以SPY代表标普500指数基金。

whyFamous.en: Buffett's own stated recommendation for ordinary investors' retirement money.
whyFamous.zh: 巴菲特亲口给出的普通投资者养老资金建议。

en: Buffett 90/10 portfolio
Buffett S&P 500 index fund 90% bonds 10%
Buffett trust instructions wife
zh: 巴菲特 遗嘱 90%标普500 10%短债

honestCaveat.en: Very close to the original; the 10% sleeve earns 0% instead of short-term bond yield.
honestCaveat.zh: 与原版非常接近,只是10%部分收益为0而非短债利息。

en: The 10% short-term government bond sleeve is cash earning 0% instead of a short-term yield.
zh: 10% 的短期国债部分是收益为 0 的现金，而不是短期国债的票息。

exactRule.en: Buy 90% SPY and keep 10% in cash (0%). Rebalance at the last close of each year.
exactRule.zh: 买入 90% SPY，其余 10% 持有现金（收益 0%）。每年最后一个交易日收盘再平衡。

attributedTo.zh: 业界惯例,无单一提出者

source.title: Conventional 60% equity / 40% bond balanced portfolio

originalRules.en: 60% equities and 40% bonds, rebalanced periodically (annually or quarterly).
originalRules.zh: 60%股票、40%债券,定期(每年或每季)再平衡。

adaptation.en: Clearly labelled substitute: the 40% bond sleeve is cash at 0%, so this is effectively a 60% equity exposure with no bond diversification or income.
adaptation.zh: 明确标注的替代版:40%债券部分用0收益现金代替,实质是60%股票敞口,没有债券分散和票息。

whyFamous.en: The default balanced benchmark that most pension and advisor portfolios are measured against.
whyFamous.zh: 养老金和投顾组合最常用的默认平衡型基准。

en: 60/40 portfolio
traditional 60/40 stocks bonds
60/40 portfolio dead
zh: 股六债四 经典配置

honestCaveat.en: Without bonds this is not a true 60/40; it is a low-risk SPY/cash mix and is labelled as such.
honestCaveat.zh: 没有债券就不是真正的60/40,只是低风险的SPY/现金组合,需明确标注。

en: The whole 40% bond sleeve is cash earning 0%: no coupon income, no price gains in equity sell-offs.
This is NOT a real 60/40; it is a 60% equity, 40% cash mix.
zh: 整个 40% 的债券部分都是收益为 0 的现金：没有利息收入，股市下跌时也没有债券的价格收益。
这不是真正的 60/40，只是 60% 股票加 40% 现金的组合。

exactRule.en: Buy 60% SPY and keep 40% in cash (0%). Rebalance at the last close of each year.
exactRule.zh: 买入 60% SPY，其余 40% 持有现金（收益 0%）。每年最后一个交易日收盘再平衡。

source.title: Portfolio Charts - Golden Butterfly Portfolio (year approximate)

originalRules.en: 20% each in total US stock market, small-cap value stocks, long-term Treasuries, short-term Treasuries and gold, rebalanced annually.
originalRules.zh: 总体美股、小盘价值股、长期国债、短期国债、黄金各20%,每年再平衡。

adaptation.en: Small-cap value is folded into SPY (40% SPY total) and both bond sleeves (40%) become cash; gold stays 20%.
adaptation.zh: 小盘价值并入SPY(合计40%),两份债券(共40%)换成现金,黄金仍为20%。

whyFamous.en: A popular Permanent Portfolio variant with a stock tilt that became a staple of the 'lazy portfolio' community.
whyFamous.zh: 带股票倾向的永久组合变体,是“懒人组合”圈子的常客。

en: Golden Butterfly portfolio
Golden Butterfly Portfolio Charts
Golden Butterfly vs permanent portfolio
zh: 黄金蝴蝶组合
金蝴蝶投资组合

honestCaveat.en: Loses the small-cap value factor and bonds, and the publication year is approximate, so it only resembles the original.
honestCaveat.zh: 缺少小盘价值因子和债券,且发布年份为大致时间,仅与原版相似。

en: Both Treasury sleeves (20% long-term, 20% short-term) are cash earning 0%.
The 20% small-cap value sleeve is folded into SPY, so the value/size tilt is gone.
zh: 两个国债部分（20% 长期、20% 短期）都是收益为 0 的现金。
20% 的小盘价值被并入 SPY，价值和小盘的倾斜不复存在。

exactRule.en: Buy 40% SPY (20% total market plus 20% standing in for small-cap value) and 20% GLD and keep 40% in cash (0%). Rebalance at the last close of each year.
exactRule.zh: 买入 40% SPY（20% 全市场加 20% 代替小盘价值）和 20% GLD，其余 40% 持有现金（收益 0%）。每年最后一个交易日收盘再平衡。

source.title: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation, Journal of Wealth Management

originalRules.en: Across five asset classes (US stocks, foreign stocks, bonds, REITs, commodities) equally weighted: at each month-end hold the class if its price is above its 10-month simple moving average, otherwise hold cash/T-bills.
originalRules.zh: 对五类资产(美股、外股、债券、REITs、商品)等权:每月末价格高于10个月简单均线则持有,否则转为现金/短债。

adaptation.en: Three of the five asset classes exist here: SPY, GLD (as a real-asset proxy) and DBC. Each gets a 1/3 slot of equity and is held only while its month-end close is above the average of its last 10 month-end closes, otherwise the slot stays in cash.
adaptation.zh: 原版 5 类资产里这里只有 3 类：SPY、GLD（作为实物资产的替代）和 DBC。每类占 1/3 仓位，只有当月末收盘价高于最近 10 个月末收盘价的均值时才持有，否则该仓位放现金。

whyFamous.en: The most-downloaded tactical allocation paper and the basis of the 'timing' wave in ETF investing.
whyFamous.zh: 下载量极高的战术资产配置论文,开启了ETF择时投资的潮流。

en: Faber 10 month moving average
A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation
GTAA Faber timing model
zh: 费伯 十个月均线
费伯 战术资产配置 择时

honestCaveat.en: Uses 3 of the paper's 5 asset classes, ETFs instead of indices and a shorter sample, so results will differ from the paper.
honestCaveat.zh: 只用了论文 5 类资产中的 3 类，用 ETF 而不是指数，样本也更短，所以结果会和论文不同。

en: Foreign stocks, bonds and REITs are missing: only 3 of the 5 classes remain, so the portfolio is more concentrated and more volatile.
GLD and DBC are ETFs, not the indices used in the paper, and the sample is shorter.
zh: 缺少海外股票、债券和 REITs：5 类资产只剩 3 类，剩下的更集中、波动更大。
GLD 和 DBC 是 ETF，不是论文中的指数，样本也更短。

exactRule.en: On the last trading day of each month, for each of SPY, GLD and DBC: if the month-end close is above the average of the last 10 month-end closes, that market is ON for the next month, else OFF. Each market has a fixed 1/3 slot; OFF slots stay in cash.
exactRule.zh: 每月最后一个交易日，对 SPY、GLD、DBC 分别判断：月末收盘价高于最近 10 个月末收盘价的均值，则下个月持有该市场，否则空仓。每个市场固定占 1/3，空仓部分放现金。

name.en: Antonacci Dual Momentum (SPY vs cash only)
name.zh: 安东纳奇双动量(仅SPY对现金)

source.title: Dual Momentum Investing

originalRules.en: Monthly: compare US stocks and international stocks over 12 months (relative momentum); if the winner beats T-bills over 12 months (absolute momentum) hold it, otherwise hold aggregate bonds.
originalRules.zh: 每月比较美股与国际股的12个月表现(相对动量);若胜者12个月收益也超过国库券(绝对动量)则持有,否则转入综合债券。

adaptation.en: Only the absolute-momentum leg survives: hold SPY at month end if its 12-month return is positive (the T-bill hurdle is taken as 0), otherwise hold cash. The relative leg (US vs international stocks) is lost entirely, and the original's bond fallback is cash.
adaptation.zh: 只保留绝对动量这一半：月末若 SPY 的 12 个月收益为正（国库券门槛视为 0）就持有 SPY，否则持有现金。美股对海外股票的相对动量完全丢失，原版转入债券的部分也只能放现金。

whyFamous.en: A rigorous, evidence-based rotation model that made 'dual momentum' a household phrase among systematic investors.
whyFamous.zh: 严谨、以实证为基础的轮动模型,让“双动量”成为系统化投资者的常用词。

en: Gary Antonacci dual momentum
Dual Momentum Investing GEM
absolute momentum relative momentum
zh: 双动量策略 安东纳奇
绝对动量 相对动量

honestCaveat.en: Only the absolute-momentum half is replicated, so this is a plain SPY trend filter, not Antonacci's full model.
honestCaveat.zh: 只复制了绝对动量一半,本质是SPY趋势过滤,并非安东纳奇的完整模型。

shortName.zh: 安东纳奇双动量（仅 SPY）

en: No international stocks, so the relative-momentum comparison does not exist.
When the signal is off the original rotates into aggregate bonds; here it sits in cash earning 0%.
zh: 没有海外股票，所以相对动量的比较根本不存在。
信号关闭时原版会转入综合债券，这里只是持有收益为 0 的现金。

exactRule.en: On the last trading day of each month: if the SPY month-end close is above its month-end close 12 months earlier, hold 100% SPY for the next month, otherwise 100% cash.
exactRule.zh: 每月最后一个交易日：若 SPY 月末收盘价高于 12 个月前的月末收盘价，下个月满仓 SPY，否则空仓持有现金。

name.zh: 海龟交易法则系统1(仅做多)

attributedTo.en: Richard Dennis & William Eckhardt (rules published by Curtis Faith)
attributedTo.zh: 理查德·丹尼斯与威廉·埃克哈特(规则由柯蒂斯·费思公开)

source.title: Way of the Turtle (rules of the original Turtle program)

originalRules.en: System 1: enter on a 20-day high/low breakout and exit on a 10-day opposite breakout; position size is 1% of equity per N (20-day ATR), up to 4 units per market, long and short, across ~20 futures markets.
originalRules.zh: 系统1:突破20日高/低点入场,反向突破10日高/低点出场;每个单位的头寸规模为权益1%除以N(20日ATR),每个市场最多4个单位,多空皆做,覆盖约20个期货市场。

adaptation.en: Long-only and close-only (no highs and lows), on ten ETF, FX and crypto markets instead of ~20 futures. Position sizing is simplified to a full fixed slot (1/10 of equity) per market: no ATR-based units, no pyramiding up to 4 units, and the filter that skips a breakout after a winning one is dropped. Shorts are lost.
adaptation.zh: 只做多，并且只用收盘价（没有最高价和最低价），标的是 10 个 ETF、外汇和加密货币市场，而不是约 20 个期货。仓位简化为每个市场固定占 1/10 的整仓：没有按 ATR 计算的头寸单位，没有最多 4 个单位的加仓，也去掉了“上一次突破盈利就跳过”的过滤。空头部分丢失。

whyFamous.en: The Turtles' story, in which Dennis trained novices into a hugely profitable trend-following team, is the most famous experiment in trading.
whyFamous.zh: 丹尼斯将新手训练成盈利惊人的趋势跟踪团队的故事,是交易界最著名的实验。

en: Turtle trading rules
Way of the Turtle Curtis Faith
Dennis Eckhardt turtle 20 day breakout
zh: 海龟交易法则
海龟交易 20日突破 10日退出

honestCaveat.en: Long-only, close-based and no pyramiding on a very different market set, so only the breakout idea survives.
honestCaveat.zh: 仅做多、基于收盘价、不加仓,且市场完全不同,只保留了突破思想。

en: The volatility-based unit sizing, which was a core part of the Turtles' risk control.
Pyramiding, short selling and the skip-after-a-winner filter.
Futures markets: our ETFs, FX and crypto behave differently.
zh: 按波动率确定头寸单位，这是海龟风险控制的核心，这里没有。
加仓、做空，以及盈利后跳过下一次突破的过滤。
期货市场：我们用的 ETF、外汇和加密货币表现不同。

exactRule.en: For each of the 10 markets, at the close: enter long when the close is above the highest close of the prior 20 days; exit to cash when it is below the lowest close of the prior 10 days. Each market has a fixed 1/10 slot of equity.
exactRule.zh: 对 10 个市场分别判断，收盘时：收盘价高于前 20 日最高收盘价则做多，低于前 10 日最低收盘价则平仓。每个市场固定占 1/10 的资金。

attributedTo.en: Richard Dennis & William Eckhardt (rules published by Curtis Faith)
attributedTo.zh: 理查德·丹尼斯与威廉·埃克哈特(规则由柯蒂斯·费思公开)

source.title: Way of the Turtle (rules of the original Turtle program)

originalRules.en: System 2 is the slower Turtle system: enter on a 55-day high/low breakout and exit on a 20-day opposite breakout, with the same ATR-based unit sizing, up to 4 units per market, long and short, as commonly described by Curtis Faith.
originalRules.zh: 系统 2 是较慢的海龟系统：突破 55 日高点或低点入场，反向突破 20 日极值出场，仓位同样按 ATR 确定，每个市场最多 4 个单位，多空都做，这是 Curtis Faith 书中通行的描述。

adaptation.en: Same simplifications as System 1: long-only, close-only, ten markets instead of futures, a full fixed slot (1/10 of equity) per market instead of ATR units, no pyramiding, no shorts.
adaptation.zh: 简化方式与系统 1 相同：只做多，只用收盘价，10 个市场而非期货，每个市场固定占 1/10 的整仓而不是按 ATR 确定的单位，没有加仓，没有空头。

whyFamous.en: The slower sibling of the famous Turtle experiment: fewer trades, longer trends.
whyFamous.zh: 著名海龟实验的慢速版本：交易更少，抓更长的趋势。

en: turtle trading system 2
55 day breakout turtle
zh: 海龟交易法则系统2
55日突破

honestCaveat.en: Parameters are as commonly cited (55/20); position sizing, shorting and futures markets are not replicated, so only the breakout idea survives.
honestCaveat.zh: 参数按通行说法（55/20）；仓位管理、做空和期货市场都没有复现，只保留了突破这个想法。

en: The volatility-based unit sizing, pyramiding and short selling.
Futures markets: our ETFs, FX and crypto behave differently.
zh: 按波动率确定的头寸单位、加仓和做空。
期货市场：我们用的 ETF、外汇和加密货币表现不同。

exactRule.en: For each of the 10 markets, at the close: enter long when the close is above the highest close of the prior 55 days; exit to cash when it is below the lowest close of the prior 20 days. Each market has a fixed 1/10 slot of equity.
exactRule.zh: 对 10 个市场分别判断，收盘时：收盘价高于前 55 日最高收盘价则做多，低于前 20 日最低收盘价则平仓。每个市场固定占 1/10 的资金。

attributedTo.zh: 拉里·康纳斯与塞萨尔·阿尔瓦雷斯

source.title: Short Term Trading Strategies That Work

originalRules.en: Buy an index ETF at the close when it is above its 200-day moving average and the 2-period RSI is below 10 (some versions 5); exit at the close when it closes above its 5-day moving average.
originalRules.zh: 当指数ETF位于200日均线上方且2周期RSI低于10(部分版本为5)时收盘买入;收盘价升破5日均线时收盘卖出。

adaptation.en: Applied to SPY only, long-only, as in the book's main index tests. Uses the standard Wilder RSI; thresholds follow the 10/5 version.
adaptation.zh: 仅用于SPY,仅做多,与书中主要指数测试一致。使用标准Wilder RSI,阈值取10/5版本。

whyFamous.en: The best-known short-term mean-reversion recipe in retail trading, repeatedly cited in books and tested widely.
whyFamous.zh: 零售交易界最著名的短线均值回归配方,被各类书籍和测试反复引用。

en: Connors RSI 2 strategy
Short Term Trading Strategies That Work
RSI(2) below 10 buy above 200 day
zh: 康纳斯 RSI2 策略
RSI2 小于10 买入 200日均线

honestCaveat.en: Close to the book rule, but entry thresholds vary between editions and are given here as commonly cited.
honestCaveat.zh: 和书中的规则很接近，但不同版本的入场阈值有出入，这里按通行说法给出。

en: Only SPY: the book tests several ETFs and stocks.
Entry thresholds differ between editions (RSI below 5 or below 10); we use 10.
zh: 只用 SPY：书中还测试了其他 ETF 和个股。
不同版本的入场阈值不同（RSI 低于 5 或低于 10），我们用 10。

exactRule.en: Signal on the SPY daily close. Enter 100% SPY when the close is above its 200-day average and Wilder RSI(2) is below 10. Exit to cash when the close is above its 5-day average. Otherwise hold the current state.
exactRule.zh: 用 SPY 的日收盘价判断。收盘价在 200 日均线上方且 Wilder RSI(2) 低于 10 时满仓买入 SPY；收盘价高于 5 日均线时平仓转现金；其余时间保持原状态。

name.zh: 利弗莫尔关键点突破(简化版)

source.title: How to Trade in Stocks (Livermore 1940); Reminiscences of a Stock Operator (Lefevre 1923)

originalRules.en: Buy when price breaks out of a long consolidation through a 'pivotal point' (a prior resistance), add only as it proves right, and cut losses quickly instead of averaging down.
originalRules.zh: 价格突破长期盘整形成的“关键点”(前期阻力位)时买入,只在走势验证正确后加仓,并迅速止损而不摊平亏损。

adaptation.en: Livermore never published exact numbers. This is OUR illustration of his method: buy when the close breaks above its prior 60-day closing high, sell when it falls 10% below the highest close since entry, with a fixed 1/10 slot per market. Pyramiding, tape reading and shorts are dropped.
adaptation.zh: 利弗莫尔从未公布过具体数字。这是我们对他方法的示意：收盘价突破前 60 日收盘高点时买入，从入场后最高收盘价回落 10% 时卖出，每个市场固定占 1/10 仓位。加仓、盘口阅读和做空都没有。

whyFamous.en: Livermore is the archetypal speculator whose boom-and-bust life inspired generations of traders.
whyFamous.zh: 利弗莫尔是传奇投机者的原型,其大起大落的人生影响了几代交易者。

en: Jesse Livermore pivotal points
Livermore trading rules breakout
How to Trade in Stocks Livermore
zh: 利弗莫尔 关键点
利弗莫尔 交易法则 突破

honestCaveat.en: The 60-day and 10% parameters are our own illustration of a qualitative method, not Livermore's published rules.
honestCaveat.zh: 60日和10%这两个参数是我们对定性方法的示意,并非利弗莫尔公布的规则。

en: The 60-day window and the 10% stop are our parameters, not Livermore's.
Pyramiding, tape reading, judgement about the market and shorting.
zh: 60 日窗口和 10% 止损是我们自己设的参数，不是利弗莫尔的。
加仓、盘口阅读、对大势的判断和做空。

exactRule.en: For each of the 10 markets, at the close: when flat and the close is above the highest close of the prior 60 days, go long; exit to cash when the close is below 90% of the highest close since entry. Each market has a fixed 1/10 slot.
exactRule.zh: 对 10 个市场分别判断，收盘时：空仓且收盘价高于前 60 日最高收盘价则做多；收盘价低于入场后最高收盘价的 90% 则平仓。每个市场固定占 1/10。

name.zh: 博格尔买入并持有指数基金

source.title: The Little Book of Common Sense Investing

originalRules.en: Buy a low-cost, broad market index fund and hold it forever, ignoring market timing; Bogle suggested adding bonds by age, but the core idea is the equity index fund.
originalRules.zh: 买入低成本的宽基指数基金并长期持有,不做择时;博格尔建议按年龄配置债券,但核心是股票指数基金。

adaptation.en: 100% SPY, never rebalanced; this is the passive benchmark and the bond component Bogle suggested for older investors is omitted.
adaptation.zh: 100% SPY且不再平衡;这是被动基准,博格尔建议年长者配置的债券部分被省略。

whyFamous.en: Bogle founded Vanguard and the first index fund, making buy-and-hold the benchmark every other strategy is judged against.
whyFamous.zh: 博格尔创立了先锋集团和首只指数基金,买入持有成为衡量其他策略的基准。

en: Bogle buy and hold index fund
Little Book of Common Sense Investing
Bogle stay the course
zh: 博格尔 买入持有
常识投资 指数基金

honestCaveat.en: A faithful stock-only version; the original lets investors hold a bond share by age.
honestCaveat.zh: 忠实的纯股票版本;原版允许按年龄配置一定比例债券。

en: Bogle suggested holding bonds in proportion to age; this is the stock-only core (100% SPY).
zh: 博格建议按年龄配置债券；这里只是纯股票的核心部分（100% SPY）。

exactRule.en: Buy 100% SPY on the first day and hold it. No rebalancing, no trading.
exactRule.zh: 第一天买入 100% SPY 并一直持有，不再平衡，不交易。

source.title: Widely quoted interview remarks (Market Wizards line of interviews; exact original unverified)

originalRules.en: Jones has said that he uses the 200-day moving average of closing prices as a basic risk gauge: if price is below it, stay out or reduce.
originalRules.zh: 琼斯曾表示他把收盘价的200日均线当作基本风险指标:价格低于它就空仓或降低仓位。

adaptation.en: Our interpretation of a widely quoted remark, not a rule he published: hold SPY while its close is above its 200-day average, otherwise cash. The exact wording and source of the quote are not verified.
adaptation.zh: 这是我们对一句广为流传的话的解读，并非他公布过的规则：SPY 收盘价在 200 日均线上方时持有，否则空仓。这句话的确切措辞和出处未经核实。

whyFamous.en: A legendary macro trader's own simple line in the sand, repeated constantly in trading circles.
whyFamous.zh: 传奇宏观交易员自己的一条简单分界线,在交易圈被反复引用。

en: Paul Tudor Jones 200 day moving average
Tudor Jones 200-day rule
200 day moving average strategy
zh: 保罗都铎琼斯 200日均线
200日均线策略

honestCaveat.en: The quote's exact source is unverified, and Jones himself trades discretionarily rather than by this single rule.
honestCaveat.zh: 该言论的确切出处未经证实,而且琼斯本人是主观交易,并非只靠这一条规则。

en: Jones trades discretionarily across markets; a single mechanical rule on SPY is not his strategy.
The quote's exact wording and source are unverified.
zh: 琼斯是跨市场的主观交易，SPY 上的一条机械规则不是他的策略。
这句话的确切措辞和出处未经核实。

exactRule.en: Every day at the close: if the SPY close is above the average of its last 200 closes, hold 100% SPY, otherwise 100% cash.
exactRule.zh: 每天收盘时：若 SPY 收盘价高于最近 200 个收盘价的均值，满仓 SPY，否则空仓持有现金。

name.zh: 奥尼尔52周新高突破加8%止损

source.title: How to Make Money in Stocks (CAN SLIM)

originalRules.en: Buy leading stocks as they break out to new highs from a base, and sell if the price falls 7-8% below the purchase price.
originalRules.zh: 在龙头股从底部形态突破、创新高时买入,价格比买入价低7-8%时卖出。

adaptation.en: Stock selection (earnings growth, market leaders, volume) cannot be applied to ETFs. Only the new-high entry and the 8% loss rule survive: buy when the close reaches a new 252-day closing high, sell if it closes 8% below the entry close, fixed 1/10 slot per market.
adaptation.zh: 选股部分（盈利增长、龙头股、成交量）无法用在 ETF 上，只保留创新高买入和 8% 止损：收盘价创 252 日收盘新高时买入，收盘价比入场价低 8% 时卖出，每个市场固定占 1/10。

whyFamous.en: CAN SLIM made 'buy new highs, cut losses at 8%' a mantra for growth investors.
whyFamous.zh: CAN SLIM让“买入新高、亏8%止损”成为成长股投资者的口头禅。

en: William O'Neil 52 week high
CAN SLIM breakout 8% stop loss
How to Make Money in Stocks rules
zh: 欧奈尔 52周新高
CAN SLIM 8%止损

honestCaveat.en: Only the price-breakout and stop parts are replicated; the stock-picking fundamentals that define CAN SLIM are lost.
honestCaveat.zh: 只复制了价格突破和止损部分,定义CAN SLIM的基本面选股完全丢失。

en: CAN SLIM stock picking (earnings, leaders, volume, market direction) is the heart of the method and is absent.
No base-pattern recognition: any new 252-day high counts.
zh: CAN SLIM 的选股（盈利、龙头、成交量、大盘方向）是这个方法的核心，这里完全没有。
不识别整理形态：只要创 252 日新高就算。

exactRule.en: For each of the 10 markets, at the close: when flat and the close is at or above the highest close of the prior 252 days, go long; exit to cash when the close is at or below 92% of the entry close. Re-entry needs another new 252-day high. Fixed 1/10 slot per market.
exactRule.zh: 对 10 个市场分别判断，收盘时：空仓且收盘价不低于前 252 日最高收盘价则做多；收盘价不高于入场价的 92% 则平仓，再次入场需要再创 252 日新高。每个市场固定占 1/10。

name.zh: 温斯坦30周均线阶段分析

source.title: Secrets for Profiting in Bull and Bear Markets

originalRules.en: Buy only in Stage 2 (price above a rising 30-week moving average after a base); sell when price falls into Stage 3/4 below the declining average.
originalRules.zh: 只在第二阶段买入(底部之后价格站上上升的30周均线);价格跌回均线下方进入第三/四阶段时卖出。

adaptation.en: 30 weeks is approximated by 150 trading days; chart-pattern judgment, volume and relative strength are dropped, leaving a mechanical MA-and-slope rule on six markets.
adaptation.zh: 30周以150个交易日近似;图形判断、成交量、相对强度都省略,只剩均线加斜率的机械规则,用于6个市场。

whyFamous.en: Weinstein's four-stage framework is one of the most widely taught chart-based trend methods.
whyFamous.zh: 温斯坦的四阶段框架是被教授最广的图表趋势方法之一。

en: Stan Weinstein stage analysis
30 week moving average Stage 2
Secrets for Profiting in Bull and Bear Markets
zh: 温斯坦 阶段分析
30周均线 第二阶段

honestCaveat.en: A mechanical shortcut of a discretionary chart-reading method, so it only approximates his stage calls.
honestCaveat.zh: 把主观读图方法机械化,只能近似其阶段判断。

en: The chart-pattern judgement (base, breakout, volume, relative strength) is replaced by a mechanical average-and-slope test.
30 weeks is approximated by 150 trading days; only six markets.
zh: 对形态（底部、突破、成交量、相对强度）的判断被换成了机械的均线加斜率条件。
30 周用 150 个交易日近似；只有 6 个市场。

exactRule.en: For each of SPY, GLD, SLV, DBC, DBA and BTC-USD, at the close: enter when the close is above its 150-day average and that average is above its own value 20 trading days earlier; exit when the close falls below the average. Fixed 1/6 slot per market, OFF slots in cash.
exactRule.zh: 对 SPY、GLD、SLV、DBC、DBA 和 BTC-USD 分别判断，收盘时：收盘价高于 150 日均线且该均线高于 20 个交易日前的值则入场；收盘价跌破均线则出场。每个市场固定占 1/6，空仓部分放现金。

name.zh: 克莱诺趋势跟踪(50/100均线加50日突破)

source.title: Following the Trend: Diversified Managed Futures Trading

originalRules.en: Long when the 50-day average is above the 100-day average and price makes a new 50-day high; exit on a trailing stop several ATRs below the high or when the trend filter turns off; positions are risk-sized by ATR across a diversified futures portfolio.
originalRules.zh: 50日均线高于100日均线且价格创50日新高时做多;跟踪止损为高点下方数倍ATR,或趋势过滤失效时退出;仓位按ATR风险定量,覆盖多元化期货组合。

adaptation.en: Long-only on ten markets, close-only: N (the ATR proxy) is the 100-day mean absolute close-to-close change. Risk-based position sizing is replaced by a fixed 1/10 slot per market, and the futures breadth and short side are lost.
adaptation.zh: 10 个市场只做多，只用收盘价：N（ATR 的替代）取 100 日平均绝对涨跌幅。按风险确定仓位被换成每个市场固定 1/10，期货的广度和空头都没有。

whyFamous.en: A modern, openly documented description of how managed-futures funds trade trends.
whyFamous.zh: 对管理期货基金如何做趋势交易的现代、公开的详细说明。

en: Clenow Following the Trend
Clenow 50 100 moving average breakout
Andreas Clenow trend following rules
zh: 克莱诺 跟随趋势
克莱诺 50日 100日均线 趋势

honestCaveat.en: The 3-N stop and the 50/100 averages are as commonly cited; they may differ from the book, and risk-based sizing is not replicated.
honestCaveat.zh: 3 倍 N 的止损和 50/100 日均线按通行说法给出，可能与书中不同，按风险定仓位也没有复现。

en: Risk-based sizing: every market gets the same slot regardless of its volatility.
The short side and the hundred-plus futures markets of the original.
zh: 按风险定仓位：不管波动率高低，每个市场都是同样的仓位。
原版的空头部分，以及上百个期货市场。

exactRule.en: For each of the 10 markets, at the close: when flat, enter if the 50-day average is above the 100-day average and the close is at or above the highest close of the prior 50 days. Exit when the 50-day average falls below the 100-day average or the close is more than 3 N below the highest close since entry. Fixed 1/10 slot per market.
exactRule.zh: 对 10 个市场分别判断，收盘时：空仓时，若 50 日均线高于 100 日均线且收盘价不低于前 50 日最高收盘价则入场；50 日均线跌破 100 日均线，或收盘价比入场后最高收盘价低 3 个 N 时出场。每个市场固定占 1/10。

attributedTo.en: Anonymous BitcoinTalk poster 'GameKyuubi' (originator of the term)
attributedTo.zh: BitcoinTalk 用户 GameKyuubi(该词的创造者)

source.title: 'I AM HODLING' BitcoinTalk forum post

originalRules.en: Buy bitcoin and hold through volatility without trading.
originalRules.zh: 买入比特币,在波动中不交易、长期持有。

adaptation.en: 100% BTC-USD from the first available date (2014-09), never rebalanced. History starts only in 2014, so the huge early Bitcoin gains are not in the sample.
adaptation.zh: 从第一个可用日期（2014 年 9 月）起 100% 持有 BTC-USD，从不再平衡。历史从 2014 年才开始，比特币最早期的巨大涨幅不在样本里。

whyFamous.en: The crypto community's defining mantra and the benchmark every crypto strategy has to beat.
whyFamous.zh: 加密社区的标志性口号,也是所有加密策略必须打败的基准。

en: bitcoin HODL strategy
I AM HODLING
bitcoin buy and hold returns
zh: 比特币 HODL
比特币 长期持有 策略

honestCaveat.en: A faithful replica of a passive idea, but the origin of the term (a 2013 forum post) is given as commonly cited.
honestCaveat.zh: 对一个被动想法的忠实复现，但“HODL”一词的来历（2013 年的一条论坛帖子）按通行说法给出。

en: Bitcoin's earliest years (before 2014-09) are not in the data.
zh: 比特币最早期（2014 年 9 月以前）不在数据里。

exactRule.en: Buy 100% BTC-USD on the first day of data and hold it. No rebalancing, no trading.
exactRule.zh: 在数据的第一天买入 100% BTC-USD 并一直持有，不再平衡，不交易。

source.title: The Mayer Multiple (Trace Mayer's bitcoin valuation metric; original publication unverified)

originalRules.en: Mayer Multiple = bitcoin price divided by its 200-day moving average; he suggested accumulating when it is below 2.4 and treating readings above 2.4 as overheated.
originalRules.zh: 梅耶倍数=比特币价格除以200日均线;他建议在低于2.4时积累,高于2.4则视为过热。

adaptation.en: Original is an accumulation guide, not a trading system; we make it a binary rule: hold BTC when the multiple is below 2.4, otherwise cash.
adaptation.zh: 原版只是积累参考,并非交易系统;这里改为二元规则:倍数低于2.4持有BTC,否则持现金。

whyFamous.en: The best-known simple valuation gauge for bitcoin tops and bottoms.
whyFamous.zh: 最知名的比特币顶部与底部简易估值指标。

en: Mayer Multiple bitcoin
Trace Mayer 2.4 200 day
Mayer Multiple 2.4 threshold
zh: 梅耶倍数 比特币
比特币 200日均线 2.4

honestCaveat.en: The 2.4 threshold is as popularly quoted; turning an accumulation guide into a sell-to-cash rule is our own adaptation.
honestCaveat.zh: 2.4阈值取自流行说法;把积累参考改成清仓转现金的规则是我们自己的改编。

en: The Mayer Multiple is an accumulation guide, not a trading system; turning it into sell-to-cash is our own step.
The 2.4 threshold is as popularly quoted and the original publication is unverified.
zh: 梅耶倍数是一个积累参考，不是交易系统；把它变成“超过就卖出转现金”是我们自己加的一步。
2.4 的阈值按流传的说法给出，原始出处未经核实。

exactRule.en: Every day at the close: M = BTC-USD close divided by the average of its last 200 closes. If M is below 2.4, hold 100% BTC-USD, otherwise 100% cash.
exactRule.zh: 每天收盘时：M = BTC-USD 收盘价 ÷ 最近 200 个收盘价的均值。M 低于 2.4 则满仓 BTC-USD，否则空仓持有现金。

attributedTo.zh: 斯文·鲍曼与本·雅各布森

source.title: The Halloween Indicator, 'Sell in May and Go Away': Another Puzzle, American Economic Review

originalRules.en: Stocks earn most of their returns from November to April; hold equities in the winter half-year and stay out (cash) May to October.
originalRules.zh: 股票收益大多来自11月至次年4月;冬季半年持有股票,5月至10月空仓(现金)。

adaptation.en: Applied to SPY only; the paper studied 37 countries, and out-of-season money is held as cash at 0%.
adaptation.zh: 只用于SPY;原论文研究37个国家,休整期资金以0收益现金持有。

whyFamous.en: The origin of the 'Sell in May and go away' market proverb, with academic backing.
whyFamous.zh: “五月卖出走人”这句市场谚语有学术背书的出处。

en: Halloween indicator Bouman Jacobsen
Sell in May and go away
Halloween effect stocks
zh: 万圣节效应 股市
五月卖出 十一月买入

honestCaveat.en: Faithful for the rule, but only one US index instead of 37 markets.
honestCaveat.zh: 规则本身忠实,但只用一个美国指数,而非37个市场。

en: One market (SPY) instead of the 37 countries studied.
Out-of-season money is cash earning 0%, not T-bills.
zh: 只有一个市场（SPY），而论文研究了 37 个国家。
休市季节的资金放在收益为 0 的现金里，而不是国库券。

exactRule.en: Hold 100% SPY from the close of the last trading day of October to the close of the last trading day of April; hold cash from there until the last trading day of October.
exactRule.zh: 从 10 月最后一个交易日收盘起，到次年 4 月最后一个交易日收盘止，满仓 SPY；其余时间持有现金。

attributedTo.zh: 约瑟夫·拉科尼肖克与埃德温·斯米特

source.title: Are Seasonal Anomalies Real? A Ninety-Year Perspective, Review of Financial Studies

originalRules.en: Using 90 years of Dow data, nearly all price gains came in the four trading days around the turn of the month, from the last trading day to the third trading day of the new month.
originalRules.zh: 基于90年道琼斯数据,几乎所有涨幅出现在月末最后一个交易日到下月第三个交易日的四个交易日内。

adaptation.en: SPY only. We hold the window from the close before the last trading day through the third trading day of the next month, so the last day's return is captured; cash otherwise.
adaptation.zh: 仅用SPY。我们持有从“月末最后一个交易日的前一天收盘”到“下月第3个交易日收盘”的窗口,以涵盖最后一天的涨幅;其余时间持现金。

whyFamous.en: A founding academic paper on calendar anomalies, now a standard reference in seasonality research.
whyFamous.zh: 日历异象的奠基性学术论文,至今仍是季节性研究的标准参考。

en: turn of the month effect
Lakonishok Smidt seasonal anomalies
turn-of-month SPY strategy
zh: 月初效应 股市
月末月初效应 策略

honestCaveat.en: The window boundaries follow our reading of the paper, so the exact days may differ by a day.
honestCaveat.zh: 窗口边界按我们对论文的理解设定，具体的日子可能相差一天。

en: The exact window follows our reading of the paper and may differ by a day.
SPY instead of the Dow Jones index over 90 years.
zh: 具体窗口按我们对论文的理解，可能相差一天。
用 SPY，而不是 90 年的道琼斯指数。

exactRule.en: Buy 100% SPY at the close of the second-to-last trading day of each month; sell to cash at the close of the 3rd trading day of the next month. Otherwise hold cash.
exactRule.zh: 每月倒数第二个交易日收盘时满仓买入 SPY，下个月第 3 个交易日收盘时卖出转现金，其余时间持有现金。

attributedTo.en: Tobias Moskowitz, Yao Hua Ooi, Lasse Pedersen
attributedTo.zh: 托比亚斯·莫斯科维茨、欧耀华、拉瑟·佩德森

source.title: Time Series Momentum, Journal of Financial Economics

originalRules.en: For each of 58 liquid futures and forwards, go long if the past 12-month excess return is positive and short if negative, hold one month, size to a 40% annualized volatility target per instrument.
originalRules.zh: 对58个流动性期货与远期,过去12个月超额收益为正则做多、为负则做空,持有一个月,每个品种按40%年化波动率目标定仓。

adaptation.en: Ten markets instead of 58 futures and forwards; long-only (negative momentum means cash, not short); a fixed 1/10 slot per market instead of per-instrument volatility targeting; monthly signals from month-end closes.
adaptation.zh: 10 个市场而不是 58 个期货和远期；只做多（动量为负时空仓，不做空）；每个市场固定占 1/10，而不是按单品种波动率定仓位；用月末收盘价产生月度信号。

whyFamous.en: The paper that established time-series momentum as a cross-asset premium and underpins CTA trend following.
whyFamous.zh: 确立时间序列动量为跨资产溢价的论文,也是CTA趋势跟踪的理论基础。

en: time series momentum Moskowitz Ooi Pedersen
12 month trend following all markets
TSMOM
zh: 时间序列动量
12个月动量 趋势跟踪

honestCaveat.en: A long-only, 10-market, unlevered cut of a long/short 58-market vol-targeted strategy, so returns will be far from the paper.
honestCaveat.zh: 这是多空、58个市场、波动率定仓策略的仅做多、10市场、无杠杆缩减版,收益与论文差距很大。

en: Short positions and volatility targeting, both central to the paper.
Bond and equity-index futures breadth: 10 markets, some of them (crypto) not in the original.
zh: 空头和波动率目标，这两点都是论文的核心。
债券和股指期货的广度：这里只有 10 个市场，其中加密货币在原论文里没有。

exactRule.en: On the last trading day of each month, for each of the 10 markets: if the month-end close is above the month-end close 12 months earlier, hold a 1/10 slot in that market for the next month, otherwise that slot stays in cash.
exactRule.zh: 每月最后一个交易日，对 10 个市场分别判断：月末收盘价高于 12 个月前的月末收盘价，下个月持有 1/10 仓位，否则该仓位放现金。

attributedTo.zh: 艾伦·莫雷拉与泰勒·缪尔

source.title: Volatility-Managed Portfolios, Journal of Finance

originalRules.en: Scale the exposure to a risk factor inversely to its recent realized variance, holding less when volatility is high, which raised risk-adjusted returns; this is the basis of volatility targeting.
originalRules.zh: 按近期已实现方差的倒数调整风险因子敞口,波动大时少持有,提高风险调整后收益;这是波动率目标策略的基础。

adaptation.en: The paper scales a factor by the inverse of last month's realised variance. We use a simpler daily version: the SPY weight is 10% divided by the annualised 20-day volatility, capped at 100% (no leverage), the rest in cash.
adaptation.zh: 论文按上月已实现方差的倒数调整因子的暴露。我们用更简单的每日版本：SPY 权重 = 10% ÷ 20 日年化波动率，上限 100%（不加杠杆），其余放现金。

whyFamous.en: A highly cited paper showing that risk scaling beats plain buy-and-hold, the basis of risk-managed funds.
whyFamous.zh: 一篇高引用论文,证明风险调整优于简单买入持有,是风险管理型基金的理论基础。

en: volatility managed portfolios Moreira Muir
volatility targeting 10%
risk targeting SPY strategy
zh: 波动率管理组合
波动率目标 10%

honestCaveat.en: The paper's exact method and the 10% target are not identical; this is the commonly used practical implementation.
honestCaveat.zh: 论文的具体方法与10%目标并不完全一致,这是常见的实用做法。

en: The paper's monthly realised-variance scaling and its factor portfolios.
No leverage: in calm markets the original would run above 100%.
zh: 论文里按月已实现方差调整以及它的因子组合。
不加杠杆：在平静的市场里，原版的暴露会超过 100%。

exactRule.en: Every day at the close: sigma = standard deviation of the last 20 SPY daily returns times the square root of 252. SPY weight = the smaller of 100% and 10% / sigma; the rest is cash.
exactRule.zh: 每天收盘时：sigma = 最近 20 个 SPY 日收益的标准差乘以 252 的平方根。SPY 权重 = 100% 与 10% ÷ sigma 中较小者，其余放现金。
